items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Sometimes I hear Tommy Dorsey records and Jack Leonard was the singer before Frank Sinatra.

ctx.x: It was just so good. It was so good I don't think, maybe, I appreciated really how good he was until -- but everything was pretty excellent in those days. Sometimes I hear Tommy Dorsey records and Jack Leonard was the singer before Frank Sinatra. And those guys, they were as professional as a symphony orchestra.
